{{Vanilla|Cauldron}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''cauldron''' is an iron block that holds water, lava or powder snow. [[Matcha Flavoured]] replaces its recipe with one that gives more when made from steel.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
7 iron ingots make 2 cauldrons, where vanilla makes 1; 7 [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]] make 4. The vanilla recipe is removed. A [[stonecutter]] cuts a block of iron into 2 cauldrons and a steel alloy into 1.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/cauldron_from_iron.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
